description: This file defines a PHP trait named 'KpiServiceTrait' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Traits\Service'. The trait provides a protected method to access the 'KpiService' service from a dependency injection container. It also uses another trait 'ServiceContainerTrait' for container support. The file is part of the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically related to performance KPI service functionality.

methods.name: getKpiService
methods.description: Returns an instance of 'KpiService' by fetching it from the dependency injection container.
